translations.text: One man disparages another behind his back with malice and with slanderous words. He speaks fairly to his face, and yet he keeps that deceit in his heart, an unclean hoard.
Therefore the prophet said: "Lord of hosts, do not hand me over together with the sinful to destruction in torments, and do not let me be lost in life along with the liars,
those who have very smooth speech and cruel thoughts in the chamber of their spirit, who faithfully promise a pledge with their lips, though their intent does not go that way."
No one loves another in his heart, except for a very few, so that he truly keeps peace and spiritual love, as God commanded him.

Now that we know the remedy, let us set our minds and our hopes on what is better, so that we may possess the light of heaven above with the angels, as a help to our souls, when God chooses to bring about the end of earthly life!
